title: Fix playlist creation error for uploaded tracks

requirements.text: Fix the 'track is not in the media library' error that occurs when creating a playlist after successfully uploading a track. Ensure uploaded tracks are properly registered in the media library before playlist creation attempts.

quotes: when i try to create a playlist, i get a prompt that says track is not in the media library. the track did upload correctly i can confirm.

acceptanceCriteria: After uploading a track, the track is immediately queryable in the media library
Creating a playlist with the uploaded track completes successfully without 'track is not in the media library' error
The fix handles race conditions between upload completion and playlist creation

requirements.text: Update the CreatePlaylistFromLibraryDialog component to refresh the media library query after track selection to ensure recently uploaded tracks are available for playlist creation.
acceptanceCriteria: The dialog verifies track availability in the media library before allowing playlist creation
Users receive clear feedback if a selected track is not yet available in the library
The component automatically retries library lookup if a track is temporarily unavailable

constraints: Preserve existing upload validation and metadata extraction logic
Maintain backward compatibility with existing playlists and tracks
nonGoals: Redesigning the overall playlist creation workflow
Changing the media library data structure
Adding new upload formats or validation rules
